quote: A beginner must look upon himself as making a garden, wherein our Lord may take His delight, but in a soil unfruitful, and abounding in weeds. His Majesty roots up the weeds, and has to plant good herbs.
source: Teresa of Ávila, The Life of St. Teresa of Jesus, ch. XI, section 10 (trans. David Lewis, 3rd ed. 1904)
